rows.law: The one-word reversal (the loop's single mutation)
rows.claim: A loop song never announces its turn: the whole perspective flips when ONE word changes inside an otherwise identical repeated line, and the loop carries the shock.
rows.quote: The reversal is a single-word mutation inside an identical loop.
rows.steal: This sitting: write every chorus as an identical loop whose line-10 occurrence swaps exactly one word (bag->man, alone->again, in->out, hallway->cellar, oil->climb, keeps->is); landing spot: watch/inbox/gala_20260925/vonnegut-final/vonnegut-final-cuts.md, all six packs, gate-enforced.
rows.falsifier: A cut whose turn requires a new sentence, or whose loop line differs from its earlier occurrences by more than one word, kills the law (the gate's exactly-one-diff check goes red).

rows.claim: A hook sung twice is a belief installed, so the hook carries the WANT (never the opinion), and the opinion moves into the verses disguised as objects and clocks.
rows.quote: Repetition IS consent. A hook sung twice is a belief installed.
rows.steal: This sitting: state each cut's engineered want in one sentence, then make the hook's answer that want as a command sung three times; landing spot: the six two-line dialogue hooks in vonnegut-final-cuts.md.
rows.falsifier: Bernays' own test: play a stranger one chorus; if they cannot restate the want in their own words in one sentence, the engineering failed, no matter how good the line reads on paper.

rows.claim: Emotion is never named: one object per beat, staged flat in one line, does the narrative work, and the stake is what the object will cost, shown not said.
rows.steal: This sitting: stage the stakes-object flat in line 1 of every pack (heavy bag, key that opens nothing, chip that won't sit flat, seven coats, painted needle, clocks taken at the door); landing spot: vonnegut-final-cuts.md, gate-checked per cut.
rows.falsifier: A sheet that needs its one named emotion-word to land, or whose line-1 object carries no cost anywhere in the song, proves the law was violated.

rows.law: New words in the operator's register (no sacred cows)
rows.claim: Every cut mines the operator's own corpus for cadence and ships new words only: his posted lines are training data, never scripture, and doctrine rides into lyrics only as symbols.
rows.quote: Voice register mined from the operator's own corpus, new words throughout
rows.steal: This sitting: strip every law name, receipt number and system word out of the six cutter packs and re-voice them as situations; landing spot: vonnegut-final-cuts.md, enforced by the gate's system-word ban inside lyrics.
rows.falsifier: Any shipped lyric line that byte-matches an estate receipt line (a law phrase, a count like 2,568, a doctrine name) is a violation the gate's ban-scan catches.
